name: Sylvia
source:
Created from a spell using the cumulative energies gathered during sex. Sylvia represents Neus' perverted side, she is the embodiment of her sexuality.

Uninhibited, she does not worry about the small details and seeks all sorts of pleasure with her beloved Neron.
